correctness.rationale: For H_eff=H-i gamma|s><s|/2, imaginary eigenvalue identity and contraction show real nondissipative eigenvectors are precisely Hermitian Jacobi eigenvectors nodal at s; others decay and surviving norm is Hermitian orthogonal dark projection. Positive offdiagonals imply simple spectrum and nonzero first coordinate. Site1 no node, site2 E=0 chiral edge mode with odd-site amplitudes (-a/b)^j. Site3 nodal constraint fixes E=±a; Chebyshev recurrence and endpoint U_m(b/(2a))=0 give exactly positive roots 2cos(k pi/(m+1)). Orthogonality and discrete sine norm give 2 sin²(theta)/(m+1). Independent Hermitian spectral calculations for 60 finite cases confirm ranks and overlaps, not infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Moving a single absorber from edge site 1 to 2 to 3 is a minimal natural experiment separating complete absorption, robust chiral protection and finely tuned paired nonzero-energy dark resonances. The sharp resonance count and exact survival overlaps quantify robust versus tuned mechanisms in a natural topological chain.

final_claim: For an odd alternating a,b>0 Jacobi chain N=2m+1, single lossy sink at s=1,2,3 and first-site initial excitation, dark dimensions/survival are (0,0), (1,1/sum_(j=0)^m(a/b)^(2j)), and at s=3 are (2,2 sin²(k pi/(m+1))/(m+1)) exactly for b/a=2cos(k pi/(m+1)), k<=floor(m/2), otherwise (0,0); independent gamma>0.
limitations: Odd open chains m>=2 with positive uniform alternating couplings and one sink at site1,2,3; initial state site1.
No finite-time decay or multi-sink/disorder claim.
